summary.zh-Hans: 雅典国家花园有鸭池、植物博物馆和儿童图书馆，是城市里的公共花园。
summary.en: Athens’ National Garden is a public garden with a duck pond, a botanical museum and a children’s library.

names.zh-Hans: 斯塔夫罗斯尼亚尔霍斯公园

summary.zh-Hans: 斯塔夫罗斯尼亚尔霍斯文化中心的公园种有橄榄树、月桂和柏树，也有地中海植物园区。
summary.en: The park at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center has olive trees, laurels and cypresses, as well as a Mediterranean Garden.

summary.zh-Hans: Spanakopita 是希腊菠菜派；在雅典的做法中，也可加入鲜奶酪、其他绿叶菜和香草。
summary.en: Spanakopita is a Greek spinach pie; versions in Athens can include fresh cheese, other greens and herbs.

summary.zh-Hans: Loukoumades 是油炸的小面团球，在雅典可以吃到淋蜂蜜的版本。
summary.en: Loukoumades are small deep-fried dough balls, served in Athens in a version drenched with honey.
